summary: Noah Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 3, 2026, containing a Next Day Disclosure Return for The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited (HKEX) under Rule 13.25A/17.27A. The registrant disclosed changes in issued shares: on June 2, 2026, it issued 178,330 ordinary shares (0.053% of existing shares) upon vesting of restricted share units under the Settlement Plan at $0.00 per share. Separately, as of the closing date, it reported 563,800 shares repurchased but not yet cancelled from December 2025 to January 2026 on the NYSE at prices ranging from $1.975 to $2.101 per ADS. These buybacks were authorized under a repurchase mandate from the June 12, 2025 AGM. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The filing is a routine share issuance and capital return disclosure; watch for the completion of the share cancellations and ongoing repurchase activity.
